subject: Estimating abundance based on observation covariates - pcountOpen

messages.author: 690aade5fb2108d0
messages.subject: Estimating abundance based on observation covariates - pcountOpen
parts:
Hi All,

I am new to the unmarked world and looking for advice.

My ecological questions are fairly straight forward: Examine stream insect responses to changing antecedent river flows. Specifically, what is the relationship between flow and survival and recruitment rates for different sampling periods (i.e. different flow conditions)?

I sampled 8 sites on 12 occasions (every 60 days for 2 years), I'm assuming the primary period is 12. I also have a measure of flow between successive sampling occasions for each site.

Using pcountOpen, I was hoping to model the changes in abundance between sampling occasions as a function of flow. However, flow is a obsCov and doesn't seem to be modelled against recruitment or survival. I think this might be related to how I structure the data in unmarkedFramePCO, but I'm not sure.

Any help would be appreciated. 

Thanks
Andrew

parts: I think those should be included as yearlySiteCovs, not obsCovs. It seems like obsCovs are typically for detection covariates, at least in other unmarked functions.
